entry.title: Morgan Stanley’s Weaver Warns of Risks in AI-Compute Bottleneck
entry.summary: Companies are seeing increasingly meaningful artificial intelligence adoption, but constraints on computing supply remain a bottleneck for growth, according to Morgan Stanley’s Michelle Weaver.

entry.title: Mark Bezos’ Fund Faces Fight to Recoup Losses From Fence Startup
entry.summary: A venture capital firm co-founded by Jeff Bezos’ younger brother Mark sank $11.7 million into a startup that fashioned itself as an Uber of fence installation. Now it’s suing the startup’s founder after the company’s collapse amid allegations of fraud and mismanagement.

entry.title: Nvidia-Backed Startup CodeRabbit Valued at $1.5 Billion in Round
entry.summary: CodeRabbit Inc., an artificial intelligence-powered code review service, has raised $143 million in a new funding round, tapping into demand for tools to spot flaws in AI-generated software programming.

entry.title: Whoop Plans to Double Size of Boston Headquarters Ahead of IPO
entry.summary: Whoop Inc., the maker of popular screenless fitness trackers, plans to roughly double the size of its Boston headquarters, boosting a city struggling to grab a bigger piece of the artificial intelligence boom.

entry.title: Wintermute Plans $1 Billion AI Investment to Compete on Wall Street
entry.summary: Wintermute Trading Ltd. intends to invest about $1 billion in high-frequency trading and artificial intelligence data center infrastructure over the next five years, as the digital assets market maker looks to diversify into traditional markets following a slump in crypto.

entry.title: AI Coding Startup Lovable Raises $400 Million at $13.3 Billion Valuation
entry.summary: Swedish coding startup Lovable has raised funding at a $13.3 billion valuation, bringing in fresh capital to compete with larger rivals like Anthropic and Elon Musk’s SpaceX.

entry.title: OpenAI lets employees cash out another $7 billion in stock
entry.summary: OpenAI wrapped up a $7 billion stock buyback, letting current and former employees sell shares at the company's $852 billion valuation. The move is meant to ease pressure on employees waiting for liquidity ahead of a potential IPO. OpenAI ran a similar $6.6 billion sale in October 2025. entry.title: Upwork CEO on AI Disruption Concerns, Earnings Slide
entry.summary: Hayden Brown, CEO of Upwork, discusses the company's recent financial performance after its full-year forecast missed analyst estimates, leading to a significant drop in the stock price. Brown discusses the sources of pressure facing Upwork and how the company plans to adapt to these challenges. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Accel Raises $3.5 Billion to Invest in Emerging Global AI Startups
entry.summary: Accel, a global venture capital firm with offices in Silicon Valley, London and Bangalore, India, has raised $3.5 billion in new funds for early-stage investments across the world.

entry.title: Should I Raise Venture Capital or Bootstrap?
entry.summary: The framing that causes the most damage is treating this as a financing decision. It is not. Taking venture money is choosing a category of business: one that must attempt to become very large very quickly, and produce an exit that returns a fund. Everything else follows from that. What venture capital actually requires A venture fund needs a small number of investments to return the entire fund.

entry.summary: OpenAI has completed a deal to help employees sell roughly $7 billion worth of shares in the company ahead of a possible Wall Street debut, according to a person familiar with the matter.

entry.summary: The highly anticipated initial public offering of Yushu Technology Co., known as Unitree Robotics, drew huge demand from retail investors as China’s leading humanoid robot maker opened books in Shanghai.
